svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Donut chart (obc-donut-chart, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Charts. Box 240x240 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_value1 (default 0, read): Slice 1 value _ps_label1 (default 'A', read): Slice 1 label (empty = slice hidden) _pn_value2 (default 0, read): Slice 2 value _ps_label2 (default 'B', read): Slice 2 label (empty = slice hidden) _pn_value3 (default 0, read): Slice 3 value _ps_label3 (default 'C', read): Slice 3 label (empty = slice hidden) _pn_value4 (default 0, read): Slice 4 value _ps_label4 (default '', read): Slice 4 label (empty = slice hidden) _pn_max (default 100, read): Total of the ring (slices are drawn against it) _ps_centerLabel (default 'Total', read): Label under the centre value _ps_unit (default '%', read): Unit of the centre value _pb_legend (default false, read): Show legend
